Question B-008-005-008.

Why the correct answer is right: Band-pass filters on the receivers admit each assigned band and attenuate transmitters on other Field Day bands.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Low-pass": A low-pass filter only rejects higher frequencies; it would not isolate one assigned band from all other bands.
- sourceIndex 2: "High-pass": A high-pass filter only rejects lower frequencies, so it is not enough for separating multiple assigned bands.
- sourceIndex 3: "Band-reject": A band-reject filter removes one range, but each receiver needs to pass its own band and reject the rest.
